This is original audio for a cozy dark-fantasy comedy, 2D quarter-view castle-defense game. It must be new material, not an imitation of any artist, franchise, existing song, or copyrighted melody.

Compose an original instrumental game soundtrack lasting about 120 seconds. 76 BPM, A minor. Mending flags after a difficult defense, affectionate recovery rather than tragedy. Felt piano, bass clarinet, viola and faint hand percussion; gentle minor-key resilience with warm suspended chords, emotionally neutral enough for either result, no funeral march. Develop a complete original 120-second instrumental arc, with compatible opening and final two seconds for a seamless loop. Keep the arrangement readable under frequent combat sound effects. No vocals, spoken words, choir syllables, or recognizable samples. Build a coherent arc without a hard ending. Keep the opening and final two seconds texturally compatible so they can be crossfaded into a seamless loop.
